column1: # Cold builds of the candidate compiler sampled for the 2026-11 recompute of `performance-candidate-compiler`; see time-budgets.md, "The first compiler build's extra time".

# One row per job of the temporary workflow `tmp-candidate-samples.yml` that built the compiler into an empty target directory after the untimed toolchain preparation and printed `== END performance-candidate-compiler: <seconds> s, exit 0 ==`.

# Each of these jobs shows 9 `Compiling` lines and no cache action. Jobs on a model with no column of the table, and jobs on a class that already had 20 counted runs, built nothing and are not listed.
# Columns: batch (1 to 8), workflow run id, job id, class of `.github/time-budgets.txt`, CPU model as `lscpu` prints it, stage time in hundredths of a second, time the stage ended.
